repos.description: An AI skill that provides design intelligence for building professional UI/UX across multiple platforms.
repos.summary_zh: UI UX Pro Max Skill 是一款AI驱动的设计智能工具，通过100条推理规则和67种UI样式库，实现专业级设计系统的自动生成。支持多平台框架，提供Python CLI命令行接口，可快速分析项目需求并输出定制化UI/UX方案，涵盖从布局模式到视觉风格的完整设计体系，显著提升设计效率与一致性。
repos.summary_en: UI UX Pro Max Skill is an AI-powered design intelligence tool that automatically generates professional design systems using 100 reasoning rules and 67 UI style libraries. Featuring a Python-based CLI, it analyzes project requirements and outputs customized UI/UX solutions—from hero-centric conversion patterns to soft UI evolution styles—enabling rapid creation of cohesive, production-ready design systems across web and mobile platforms while dramatically improving design efficiency, ensuring brand consistency, and reducing development iteration cycles.

repos.description: Reverse Engineering / Authorized Penetration Testing / Security Research Skill Router Pack AI-powered routing + On-demand toolchain bootstrapping + Self-evolving knowledge base  Supports Claude Code, Kiro, Cursor, Cline, and other AI coding clients 逆向/渗透/安全技能路由包 - AI 自动路由 + 按需自举工具链 + 自动进化经验库 | 支持 Claude Code / Kiro / Cursor / Cline 等代码 AI 客户端
repos.summary_zh: reverse-skill 是一个面向 AI 编码客户端的逆向工程、授权渗透测试与安全研究技能路由包。它通过 AI 驱动的路由矩阵与 RULES.md，自动将 APK、二进制、JS 加密、CTF、固件等任务导向正确方法论和工具链。核心亮点包括按需自举工具链、自进化知识库，以及与 IDA Pro、Ghidra、Frida 等集成，避免盲目猜命令，实现经验复用。支持 Claude Code、Cursor 等客户端，多平台部署，显著提升安全研究效率。
repos.summary_en: reverse-skill is an AI-powered skill router pack for reverse engineering, authorized penetration testing, and security research, designed for AI coding clients like Claude Code and Cursor. It automatically routes tasks involving APKs, binaries, JS encryption, CTF, and firmware to the correct methodologies and tools via a routing matrix and RULES.md. Highlights include on-demand toolchain bootstrapping, a self-evolving knowledge base, and integration with IDA Pro, Ghidra, and Frida. It prevents blind command guessing, enables experience reuse, and supports cross-platform deployments for efficient security workflows.

repos.description: A full-featured, hackable Next.js AI chatbot built by Vercel
repos.summary_zh: Vercel开源的全功能AI聊天机器人模板，基于Next.js 14 App Router与React Server Components构建。集成Vercel AI SDK提供统一LLM API，默认支持xAI，可无缝切换OpenAI等提供商。采用shadcn/ui组件与Tailwind CSS样式，数据持久化依托Neon Serverless Postgres和Vercel Blob存储，内置Auth.js认证。支持一键部署至Vercel，为开发者提供开箱即用的可扩展聊天应用解决方案。
repos.summary_en: Vercel's open-source, full-featured AI chatbot template built with Next.js 14 App Router and React Server Components. Powered by Vercel AI SDK for unified LLM API access, defaulting to xAI while supporting seamless integration with OpenAI, Anthropic, and other providers. Features shadcn/ui components styled with Tailwind CSS, data persistence via Neon Serverless Postgres and Vercel Blob storage, and Auth.js authentication. Enables developers to quickly build and deploy hackable chatbot applications with one-click Vercel deployment.

repos.description: Admin Dashboard UI built with Shadcn and Vite.
repos.summary_zh: satnaing/shadcn-admin 是基于 Shadcn UI 和 Vite 构建的企业级管理后台 UI 组件库。提供 10+ 预置页面、响应式布局、亮暗主题切换及完善的 RTL 语言支持，深度优化可访问性。通过自定义 Shadcn 组件与 TanStack Router 集成，为开发者提供可直接复用的生产级界面解决方案，显著加速后台系统开发。
repos.summary_en: satnaing/shadcn-admin is a production-grade admin dashboard UI library built with Shadcn UI and Vite. It features 10+ pre-built pages, responsive layouts, light/dark themes, comprehensive RTL support, and deep accessibility optimization. By customizing Shadcn components and integrating TanStack Router, it delivers reusable, enterprise-ready UI solutions that dramatically accelerate backend development.

repos.description: Beautiful map components. 100% Free, Zero config, one command setup.
repos.summary_zh: mapcn 是一个免费开源的 React 地图组件库，提供零配置、一键集成的地图解决方案。基于 MapLibre GL 构建，深度集成 Tailwind CSS 和 shadcn/ui 样式体系，支持主题感知、可组合组件、标记弹窗、路线绘制等核心功能，适用于快速开发美观的地图可视化应用。
repos.summary_en: mapcn is a free, open-source React map component library that provides zero-config, one-command setup for beautiful map visualizations. Built on MapLibre GL and styled with Tailwind CSS, it seamlessly integrates with shadcn/ui design patterns. Key features include theme-aware light/dark mode adaptation, composable map components, rich markers with popups and tooltips, route/path drawing capabilities, and built-in controls—enabling rapid development of sophisticated map-based applications.

repos.description: Turn your Notion workspace into a fast, customizable website. Built with Next.js + Notion API, with multi-platform deployment and no self-hosted server required.
repos.summary_zh: NotionNext是基于Next.js与Notion API构建的高颜值静态博客系统，支持Vercel等多种部署方案，实现零服务器成本的网站搭建。专为创作者设计，可将Notion页面无缝转化为博客内容，提供主题定制、SEO优化及自动化部署能力，大幅降低技术门槛。
repos.summary_en: NotionNext is a visually appealing static blog system built with Next.js and Notion API, supporting multiple deployment options like Vercel for zero-server website setup. Designed for creators, it seamlessly transforms Notion pages into blog content with theme customization, SEO optimization, and automated deployment, significantly lowering technical barriers.

repos.description: 🏋 Modern open-source fitness coaching platform. Create workout plans, track progress, and access a comprehensive exercise database.
repos.summary_zh: Workout.cool 是一个现代开源健身教练平台，支持创建个性化训练计划、追踪健身进度，并提供包含详细说明与视频演示的全面运动数据库。基于 Next.js 16、Prisma ORM 和 Feature-Sliced Design 架构构建，具备 Docker 自托管、多语言支持及 Stripe 集成，旨在为健身开源社区提供可靠、可维护的自托管解决方案。
repos.summary_en: Workout.cool is a modern open-source fitness coaching platform for creating personalized workout plans, tracking progress, and accessing a comprehensive exercise database with detailed instructions and video demos. Built on Next.js 16, Prisma ORM, and Feature-Sliced Design architecture, it supports Docker self-hosting, i18n, and Stripe integration, reviving reliable tools for the fitness open-source community.

repos.description: Animated components for design engineers. 150+ free shadcn/ui components, built with Tailwind CSS and Motion. MIT licensed.
repos.summary_zh: 为设计工程师打造的UI组件库，提供92+可复制的AI智能体模式与4个全栈模板。基于Tailwind CSS开发，完全兼容Shadcn，支持一键复制、Next.js导出或v0导入，快速构建可访问的定制化界面。
repos.summary_en: UI component library for Design Engineers featuring 92+ copy-paste AI Agent patterns and 4 full-stack templates. Built with Tailwind CSS, fully Shadcn-compatible. Integrate via copy-paste, Next.js export, or v0 import for accessible, customizable interfaces.

repos.description: Open-source ThreeUI Community catalog with live interactive components and complete Community source.
repos.summary_zh: ThreeUI Community 是开源的 Three.js/WebGL 3D 组件与交互 Shader 目录，含 50 个父组件、164 个可浏览结果。提供实时预览、变体控制、源码查看与 React 封装包，支持 npm 安装。适用于落地页 Hero、3D 背景与视觉特效开发，MIT 许可，免登录获取完整社区实现。
repos.summary_en: ThreeUI Community is an open-source catalog of procedural Three.js/WebGL 3D components and interactive shaders, featuring 50 parent components and 164 browse results. It offers live previews, variant controls, source access, and a React package via npm. Ideal for hero sections, 3D backgrounds, and visual effects. MIT-licensed, no login required.

repos.description: A library of behaviors for agents to build the next generation of user interfaces.
repos.summary_zh: UI SDK 是一个为 AI 智能体设计的用户界面行为库，提供键盘导航、焦点管理、选择、弹出、拖放等交互行为，并内置 ARIA 无障碍支持。通过 @ui-sdk/core 定义原始组件，可无缝适配 React、Vue、Svelte、Solid 和 Web Components，助力智能体快速生成下一代 UI。
repos.summary_en: UI SDK is a library of behaviors for AI agents to build next-generation user interfaces. It provides keyboard navigation, focus, selection, dismissal, popups, drag-and-drop, and ARIA accessibility. Built on @ui-sdk/core, it offers adapters for React, Vue, Svelte, Solid, and Web Components, enabling agents to generate UIs seamlessly.

repos.description: 🤹 Access thousands of icons as components on-demand universally.
repos.summary_zh: unplugin-icons 是基于 Iconify 的通用图标组件库，提供超20万图标并支持150+图标集。通过按需加载机制仅打包实际使用的图标，显著减小构建体积。支持 Vite、Webpack 等主流构建工具及 React、Vue 3 等框架，具备自动导入、SSR/SSG 友好、自定义图标等特性，适用于现代前端项目。
repos.summary_en: unplugin-icons is a universal icon library leveraging Iconify, providing 200,000+ icons across 150+ sets. It enables on-demand loading to bundle only used icons, reducing bundle size. Compatible with major build tools (Vite, Webpack, Rollup) and frameworks (React, Vue 3, Svelte), it features auto-importing, custom icons, and SSR/SSG support without FOUC for modern web development.

repos.description: Extract any website’s design system into tokens in seconds: logo, colors, typography, borders & more. One command.
repos.summary_zh: Dembrandt 是一款一键提取任意网站设计系统的 CLI 工具。基于 Playwright 渲染页面并分析 DOM 计算样式，自动输出 Logo、颜色、字体、间距、边框、阴影、动效与组件等完整设计令牌，支持 W3C DTCG、shadcn/ui、Tailwind 等多格式导出，并可在 CI 中检测设计漂移，生成品牌指南或供 AI 代理使用。
repos.summary_en: Dembrandt is a CLI tool that extracts any website’s design system into standardized tokens in one command. Powered by Playwright, it analyzes computed DOM styles to capture logo, colors, typography, spacing, borders, shadows, motion and components. Outputs W3C DTCG, shadcn/ui, Tailwind themes and more; supports CI drift detection, brand guides and AI-agent ready DESIGN.md.

repos.description: Modern Admin Dashboard Template built with Shadcn UI and Next.js 16
repos.summary_zh: 基于Next.js 16、TypeScript与Shadcn UI的现代化管理后台模板，提供CRM、财务等多场景仪表板。支持亮暗主题切换、响应式布局与同构文件系统架构，内置Tailwind CSS v4、Zustand状态管理和TanStack Table数据处理，助力快速构建可扩展的企业级应用。
repos.summary_en: Modern admin dashboard template built with Next.js 16, TypeScript and Shadcn UI, featuring multiple pre-built dashboards for CRM, finance and other business scenarios. Supports light/dark theme switching with multiple color presets, responsive layouts, and colocation-based file system architecture for better code organization. Integrated with Tailwind CSS v4, Zustand for lightweight state management, and TanStack Table for advanced data handling. Includes authentication flows and role-based access control (planned). Enables rapid development of scalable enterprise applications with customizable themes and flexible layouts.

repos.description: Agent skills and an AI-native SwiftUI component library for iOS apps: animations, Metal shaders, charts, components and full-stack modules your coding agent can build from.
repos.summary_zh: ShipSwift 是一个 AI 原生的 SwiftUI 组件库，提供生产就绪的动画、图表、UI 组件和全栈模块配方。通过 MCP 服务器或本地技能安装，AI 工具如 Claude、Cursor 可即时获取代码与上下文，快速构建真实 iOS 应用。兼容 30+ AI 编码助手，含可搜索目录和 App Store 展示 App，还提供自定义开发服务。适用于加速原生 iOS 开发与 AI 辅助编程。
repos.summary_en: ShipSwift is an AI-native SwiftUI component library providing production-ready components and full-stack recipes for animations, charts, UI elements, and modules. Via MCP server or local skills, AI tools like Claude and Cursor instantly access code and context to build real iOS apps. Compatible with 30+ AI coding assistants, it includes a searchable catalog, App Store showcase app, and custom development services. Accelerates native iOS development with AI assistance for Swift 5.0+ and iOS 18+.

repos.summary_zh: LiftKit是一个面向设计师的UI框架，通过数学公式自动实现设计最佳实践。核心提供缩放、间距和色彩的系统化解决方案，确保视觉对称、比例平衡和色彩平滑过渡。目前仅支持Next.js，正处于重写阶段以符合现代开发标准。项目由兼职维护者开发，暂不建议生产环境使用。其平台无关的设计系统可无缝集成到现代前端工作流中。
repos.summary_en: LiftKit is a UI framework for perfectionists that automatically enforces design best practices through mathematical formulas for scaling, spacing, and color. It ensures optical symmetry, balanced proportions, and smooth color ramps without manual effort. Currently Next.js-only, it's being rewritten with Base UI primitives to meet modern standards. The designer-built system is platform-agnostic and aims to make developers better designers. Maintained by part-time contributors, it's not production-ready yet but offers a robust foundation for design-system-driven development with community-driven expansion and Tailwind integration efforts.

repos.summary_zh: Gitstars 是专为开发者设计的 GitHub 星标仓库管理工具。它解决了星标过多导致的查找难题，提供按主题/语言分类、README 预览和快速直达功能。内置的 Gitstars Ranking 每日更新 GitHub 星标 Top100 项目，支持按编程语言筛选，帮助开发者高效发现优质开源项目。支持 Vercel 一键部署，实现个人星标仓库的私有化智能管理。
repos.summary_en: Gitstars is a specialized GitHub starred repositories manager for developers. It addresses the challenge of finding repositories among numerous stars by offering categorization by topics/languages, README preview, and quick access. The built-in Gitstars Ranking updates daily with GitHub's top 100 starred projects across programming languages, enabling efficient discovery of quality open-source projects. One-click Vercel deployment enables private intelligent management of personal starred repositories.

repos.description: ✨❤️‍🔥Turn the cities you love into stunning designs
repos.summary_zh: MapPoster Online 是一款基于浏览器的地图艺术生成工具，无需安装即可将全球城市地图转化为精美海报。采用 React 19 与 TypeScript 构建前端界面，Rust WASM 处理地图渲染，Bun 作为高性能运行时。支持亚洲、欧洲、美洲等数十个热门城市，提供即时预览与高清导出，是旅行纪念与城市美学创作的理想选择。
repos.summary_en: MapPoster Online is a browser-based map art generator that transforms city maps into stunning posters without installation. Built with React 19 and TypeScript, it leverages Rust WASM for map rendering and Bun as the high-performance runtime. Supporting dozens of cities across Asia, Europe, and the Americas, it offers instant preview and HD export, ideal for travel memorabilia and urban aesthetic creation.

repos.description: A Cursor skill that gives AI agents real UI component knowledge — best practices, layout patterns, and design-system conventions for 60+ interface components — so it generates production-grade UI instead of generic output.
repos.summary_zh: 这是一个 Cursor AI 技能，为 AI 编程注入 60+ UI 组件的专业设计知识，包括最佳实践、布局模式和设计系统规范。通过消除 AI 的随意猜测，它能自动生成符合现代 SaaS、企业级或创意风格的生产级前端代码，显著提升 UI 开发质量与效率。
repos.summary_en: This Cursor AI skill provides AI agents with deep expertise on 60+ UI components, covering accessibility standards, responsive layout patterns, and design system conventions meticulously curated from component.gallery. It eliminates generic output by delivering specific best practices, common layouts, and anti-patterns for each component, automatically generating production-grade interfaces in five style presets: Modern SaaS, Apple-level Minimal, Enterprise/Corporate, Creative/Portfolio, and Data Dashboard. The result is senior-designer-quality UI code that follows proven patterns without manual template assembly, significantly accelerating frontend development workflows.

repos.summary_zh: Shadcn Builder 是为 shadcn/ui 量身打造的可视化表单构建器，通过拖拽式操作和实时预览，让开发者无需编写代码即可创建美观、可访问的表单。工具直接生成生产就绪的 React + Tailwind CSS 代码，完美契合 shadcn/ui 组件体系，实现零配置快速上手，大幅提升前端开发效率。
repos.summary_en: Shadcn Builder is a powerful no-code form builder specifically designed for the shadcn/ui component library. It enables developers to visually create beautiful, accessible forms through drag-and-drop interface with live preview, then exports clean, production-ready React + Tailwind CSS code. With zero configuration required and seamless shadcn/ui integration, it dramatically accelerates frontend development while maintaining code quality and type safety.

repos.summary_zh: 面向Svelte 5的精选生产级动效组件库，采用shadcn式copy-paste架构，通过CLI直接注入源码。封装GSAP与OGL，实现流畅WebGL与时间轴动画，覆盖磁力按钮、3D无限画廊等，专为实验性高性能网页设计打造。
repos.summary_en: Curated production-ready motion components for Svelte 5, using a shadcn-inspired copy-paste architecture via CLI. Wraps GSAP and OGL for smooth WebGL and timeline animations, including magnetic buttons and 3D galleries, focused on high-end experimental web motion design.
